end.parentNote: Asha practised naming polygons, spotting shapes in different orientations, and describing triangles by sides and angles. Veer explained that changing a triangle’s position does not change its name and used the number of sides to identify polygons. They hesitated over the word “equilateral” and gave an uncertain example about a samosa having a right angle; no later correction was recorded. At home, ask Veer to name everyday polygons and explain how many straight sides each has.
